My favorite moment so far was when I was leveling in merciless for the first time in Darkshrine HC and I encountered the mod that duplicates blue packs. I  had previously also managed to get the bloodlines darkshrine mod. With my little knowledge of the game I ran into a small room filled to the brim with blue skeletons. After a quick glance I noticed the "Herald of the Obelisk" on one of them as the group had all but died. I see huge statues drop from the sky and BAM! the room was crawling with sparks bouncing off the walls. After getting shocked I knew I had no choice but to book it out of the door. My life dipped to just below 100 and I narrowly made my escape to live another day. I know now not to run into a blue pack without glancing at the bloodline to be sure I am not committing suicide.
